newsitem.title: THAILAND: Credit Lyonnais, SCCF discuss stake. [CORRECTED 12:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais, SCCF discuss stake. [CORRECTED 12:33 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline from "Credit Lyonnais seeks higher equity stake in SCCF")

Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) said its current talks on a possible equity tie with Siam City Credit Finance and Securities Plc will likely continue into the third quarter. (Corrects to make clear that Credit Lyonnais currently does not have any stake in SCCF but is negotiating a possible equity stake in the company in the future)

"I suspect that by the third quarter we might see some progress. No decision has yet been made regarding an equity stake," Gary Coull, Chairman of Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) told Reuters by phone from Hong Kong.

SCCF, finance and broking unit of Siam City Bank Plc, said on Thursday its board proposed for Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia), a Credit Lyonnais unit, to hold up to a 45 percent stake in its planned detached securities business.
SCCF plans to split its finance and securities business later this year.
"We have a strong relationship with SCCF. We have been interested for a long time in taking a substantial equity stake and those discussions are continuing," Coull said.
"We value our relationship with these people. We are comfortable with the business...but it would be premature to suggest that a decision has been taken," he said.
